name: 8217-sonnet-mixtral8x7bgptq-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node (--gres=gpu:1).
load_profile: constant (open loop), rate = 1 request/s, warmup first 20% and cooldown last 10% by completion, bound.max_requests 300, safety_seconds 1800.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, exactly 512 prompt tokens and exactly 256 output tokens (min == max on each end), greedy `temperature: 0.0`, `request_format: plain` so the prompt reaches the engine as one raw string with no chat template. Prompts are synthetic filler and each is distinct; prefix caching is off.
purpose: A Mixtral writing assistant turning 512-token prompts into 256-token drafts at a steady one request per second on one GPU.
launch:
# The engine's launch arguments. These go straight to a September 2024 `AsyncEngineArgs`:
# an unknown key is a TypeError at construction, so do not add arguments from a later vLLM.
# Every value below is either this operating point's, this checkpoint's own, or the engine
# default written down so it cannot drift.

model: TheBloke/Mixtral-8x7B-v0.1-GPTQ
dtype: float16
tensor-parallel-size: 1
max-model-len: 4096
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
max-num-seqs: 256
block-size: 16
